zh.name: 用可见类比回应质疑
zh.summary: 把抽象质疑转成看得见的物件或场景对照，再说明类比支持的判断。
zh.useWhen: 类比是解释工具，不能冒充事实证明；区别于泛泛的并排比较。
zh.instructions: 明确质疑、对应类比、真实图片与类比边界
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Visual Analogy Opinion
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the visual analogy opinion structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the visual analogy opinion format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 首屏全幅人物/场景，上部白字42–52px提出质疑
后页上下两图，上图展示常见表面判断，下图展示与之相关的真实过程/记忆细节
